subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A', 'B' and 'C' to write five complete sentences.
stimulus: 1  5 = 5 Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) We should i. persons are not only dishonest i. but also harmful to our society. (b) Corrupt ii. high time we ii. we do not think of the welfare of our country. (c) Now, it is iii. so self-centered that iii. did something against corruption. (d) We should iv. say 'no' to corruption iv. because it is a serious social crime. (e) But we are v. work together if v. we want to control corruption.
guide_solution: (a) We should say ‘no’ to corruption because it is a serious social crime. (b) Corrupt persons are not only dishonest but also harmful to our society. (c) Now, it is high time we did something against corruption. (d) We should work together if we want to control corruption. (e) But we are so self-centered that we do not think of the welfare of our country.
